basics.name: Chengjie Fang
basics.label: Master's student in Artificial Intelligence
basics.summary: Master's student at the Hangzhou Institute for Advanced Study, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, advised by Prof. Jungang Xu. Research interests: scientific machine learning, embodied intelligence, and autonomous research agents.

work.name: ByteDance
highlights: Build agents for cross-border e-commerce logistics and supply-chain forecasting, connecting data, experimentation, and modeling platforms to automate information retrieval, task orchestration, and analysis.
Apply autonomous research workflows to delivery-time prediction through feature exploration, experiment design, result analysis, and iterative model evaluation.

work.name: Baidu
work.summary: BMU Foundation Model Department · Frontier Research
highlights: Developed an Auto Research framework for autonomous planning and iterative improvement in complex scientific workflows, with a focus on exploration strategies, context-state management, and sustained reasoning.
Designed and implemented the agent framework and experiment harness; contributed to algorithm development, experiments, and system validation.

education.institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

courses: Robotics laboratory: humanoid vision/control and robotic-arm development

publications.name: Decoupling Regime and Mechanistic Heterogeneity via Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for Global Carbon Flux Prediction
publications.summary: First author (1 of 6). Accepted. A hierarchical mixture-of-experts model that separates environmental regimes from physical mechanisms for interpretable global ocean carbon-flux forecasting.

publications.name: StageNav: A Diagnostic Benchmark and State-Aligned RL Framework for Long-Horizon Navigation
publications.summary: First author (1 of 5). Accepted. Geometrically verified task graphs and state-aligned reinforcement learning help navigation agents assess progress, recognize failure, and recover over long horizons.

publications.name: Carbon-ECS: A Benchmark and a Physics-Decoupled Model for the East China Sea Carbon Flux
publications.summary: First author (1 of 6). Published. A 17-year, approximately 1 km benchmark and a physics-inspired model that pair large-scale transport modeling with iterative refinement of local carbon-flux detail.

publications.name: ForesightNav: Adaptive Semantic-Geometric Planning for Universal Zero-Shot Goal-Oriented Navigation
publications.summary: Co-first author · 2nd listed (2 of 3). Published. A training-free navigation framework that combines semantic maps, graph-based target verification, and geometric frontier exploration for object, instance, and text goals.

publications.name: SHNet: A Lightweight Network Focusing on Shallow High-Resolution Features for PCB Defect Detection
publications.summary: Co-first author · 2nd listed (2 of 3). Published. A lightweight PCB defect detector that preserves shallow high-resolution features through multi-scale adaptation, semantic alignment, and wavelet enhancement.

publications.name: Filter-Group Mixture-of-Experts Model for Remote Sensing Forged Target Perception
publications.summary: Third author (3 of 6). Published. Specialized edge, wavelet, texture, and directional filters form an expert ensemble that detects subtle forgery traces in remote-sensing imagery.

publications.name: AnyTemplate: A Zero-shot Template Matching Approach for Arbitrary-Resolution and Scale-Agnostic Images
publications.summary: Fourth author (4 of 5). Published. A zero-shot template-matching framework that combines visual foundation models, aspect-ratio-preserving normalization, cross-attention, and geometric refinement across image scales.
